# Mock robots.txt fixture for Milestone 1 unit tests.
#
# This file simulates a real-world robots.txt that:
# - Allows normal public-facing pages
# - Disallows admin and internal paths
# - Disallows automated booking/search paths specifically
#
# Used by: apps/scraper/tests/core/test_policy_gate.py
# The RobotsPolicyGate is initialized with fixture_path pointing here,
# so tests run fully offline without any real HTTP requests.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /flights/search
Allow: /about
Allow: /contact

Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /internal/
Disallow: /api/v1/automated/
Disallow: /booking/automated/
Disallow: /.env

# Stricter rules for our research bot
User-agent: AirfareIndexBot/1.0
Allow: /
Allow: /flights/search
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /internal/
Disallow: /api/v1/automated/
Disallow: /booking/automated/
